name: card
description: Teaser tile. The parent Card Grid's card style decides the look (product teaser with button, image link with arrow, info tile, image with label chip, category tile, square image teaser).

image.description: Set the alt text in the asset's meta (translatable).

link_label.description: Only shown by the 'Product teaser' card style (outlined button); other styles show an arrow and make the whole tile the link.

view.name: Card
view.notes: Reads card_style from the parent grid (context/prop). product-teaser: image 444x291 cover, body padding 30px, h3 24/34 600, text 18/28 300 mt18, button (brand primary) mt30 with link_label, tile bg = white when the grid background is 'panel' else transparent, hover shadow rgba(0,0,0,.1) 0 0 30px. image-link: image (cut-out on colored block, 327x163 contained), h3 21/31 600 at 30px inset, 24px arrow below, whole tile = link, no bg. info: tile bg var(--color-panel), image (circle icon) centered top ~150px, padding 30px, title 18/28 600, text 18/28 300, no link. label-chip: full image 444x250 cover, white chip overlapping bottom-left (padding 30px) with headline 18 600 + inline arrow, whole tile = link; text unused. category-tile: white tile 210x328, flex column centered, padding 72 18 18, gap 24; image 110x110 contain (empty image -> nothing, label stays at the same offset); headline 21/31 600 centered var(--color-text); whole tile = link; text/link_label unused. image-square: image 444x444 cover, no bg, then headline h3 24/34 600 and text 18/28 300 with 30px left inset; link optional (whole tile when set), no button.
